turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey there, how are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm alright, a bit tired.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We spent ages asking Moshi trivia on the camping trip.

turns.speaker: other
turns.text: Who won?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, something else. I've just started night shifts at the hospital and I'm a zombie by four in the morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Night shifts are tough. Do you tend to drink one big coffee at the start, or would small cups spread through the first half of the shift suit you better?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Ooh, can I show you something?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, Moshi, I need to answer him. I'll check in again when we're finished.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did he just say platform nine or platform five?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Nine, I think. The board still says five, though.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Which one do we trust?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The announcement. Boards are always behind.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, nine's at the far end. We've got three minutes.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then stop talking and run. Grab your bag.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, the board just changed. Nine. Go, go, go.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, did you book the table for Sunday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I did, for half past one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All set over here. Can you keep going?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, for your shifts, big coffee or small and often?
